home_about_us.text_homepage_about_us:
Xiangying Glass Hardware Factory is 15 years factory with a focus on customer service, satisfaction and impeccable workmanship. We have advanced production equipment and a number of skillfull technical workers and we can offer you with the high quality products with competitive price.

We have a lot experience to export all over the world, especially in Canada, Netherlands and Australia.

We welcome all enquiries regarding Glass and Aluminium for Domestic, Architectural and Commercial applications.If you are insterested in our product, pls feel free to contact us.
